items.summary: Apple's upcoming HomeView smart home hub could also work as a HomeKit Secure Video camera, according to settings strings discovered in the device's software by code sleuth pdfu . Notably, pdfu says there's also a HomeView-specific configuration for 1080p/30fps video and microphone input , which the software selects for HomeKit Secure Video sessions. Other strings suggest that only home members will be able to view streams and recordings.
